property_summary: After a successful renounceOwnership (which internally calls _transferOwnership(address(0))), the owner must be the zero address, but due to the bug in the mutant's _transferOwnership that passes _msgSender() instead of the original newOwner, the ownership will not be transferred to the zero address.
change_summary: Replace _transferOwnership call with a call that passes msg.sender instead of newOwner, so ownership goes to caller not parameter
